en.headline: Customs seize 53.9 kg of suspected cocaine worth HK$36.2 million in Mong Kok
en.dek: A 49-year-old foreign man was arrested after officers found 11 kg in his backpack outside a Central hotel and a further 42.9 kg at a residential unit in Mong Kok.
body: Hong Kong Customs announced on Friday that officers had dismantled a drug storage and distribution centre in Mong Kok, seizing about 53.9 kilograms of suspected cocaine with an estimated street value of HK$36.2 million. A 49-year-old foreign man was arrested on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs.

Acting on intelligence shared with overseas agencies, officers stopped the man outside a hotel in Central on the evening of 26 August. He attempted to flee and resisted, but was subdued. Eleven kilograms of suspected cocaine were found in his backpack. A subsequent search of a private residential unit in Mong Kok yielded a further 42.9 kilograms.

Customs said the man had frequently changed hotels in an apparent attempt to evade detection. He was detained for further inquiries and will be charged with trafficking in dangerous drugs. Officers described the operation as having intercepted a large quantity of narcotics at source before they could reach the street market.

zh.headline: 海關旺角搗毒品倉檢53.9公斤可卡因 拘外籍男
zh.dek: 49歲外籍男子在中環酒店外被截查，背囊藏11公斤懷疑可卡因，旺角住宅再起獲42.9公斤，市值約3,620萬元。
body: 香港海關周五公布，成功搗破旺角一個毒品儲存及分銷中心，共檢獲約53.9公斤懷疑可卡因，估計市值約3,620萬港元，並拘捕一名49歲外籍男子，涉嫌販運危險藥物。
關員早前與海外執法機構情報交流後，於8月26日晚上在中環一間酒店大門外截查該名男子。男子一度企圖逃走並激烈反抗，最終被制服，人員在其隨身背囊內搜獲11公斤懷疑可卡因。其後在旺角一個私人住宅單位再檢獲約42.9公斤懷疑可卡因。
海關表示，被捕男子頻密轉換酒店藏身，增加追查難度，但最終難逃法網。他現正被扣留調查，稍後將被落案控以販運危險藥物罪。關員指行動已成功在源頭截獲大批毒品，阻止其流入市面。
